notes: Site authors almost no custom properties: the only brand ones are --irnmn--color--dark-grey (#3e3a37) and --irnmn--color--light-grey (#efe4d6); the other 27 belong to the litepicker date-picker and WordPress presets and were discarded. Palette hexes are exact (from theme CSS + computed-style frequency), except surface #fef9f3 / #fef9f2, which the profile reports as two near-identical alternate-band creams — collapsed to one. `muted` (#9e9e9e) is NOT a body-text tier: the site has none (all text is #3e3a37); #9e9e9e appears only on the carousel `1 — 5` position counter and vendor UI. `focus` (#415922) is an olive used exclusively for focus outlines, never as brand colour. Type scale normalized to rem from the site's named px ladder (14/16/20/24/32/40/48/56/72/80/96/136/195px); the 195 and 136 steps and the 12.8px/13.3px browser em-fallbacks were dropped from `scale`, and the 0.5625rem (9px) eyebrow kept. Raw weights 100 and 700 are single-use (a thin display cut, a bold vendor button) and dropped. Radius: raw 3px exists only inside the date picker, 24px on chips is really a pill (normalized to 9999px), and 100% on two arrow buttons; the page's real system is {0, pill}. Exactly one box-shadow exists on the page (a modal), so there is no elevation scale. The site does not re-theme for dark (`craft.theme.supportsDark: false`) — `color.dark` is omitted rather than invented; the reported `theme.dark` payload is just the light palette. Motion durations exclude the profile's 3000ms entry, which belongs to the announcement-bar dwell timer, not a transition.
